articles.title: The Fallen Walkthrough - The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Fallen follows immediately after defeating Alduin for the first time in Alduin's Bane, and is the fourteenth main quest in Skyrim. With Alduin having
articles.body:
The Fallen follows immediately after defeating Alduin for the first time in Alduin's Bane , and is the fourteenth main quest in Skyrim . With Alduin having escaped after your tussle, you now have to track down one of his allies to find out what he's doing next.

Get Greybeards' help in negotiating a truce

Learn the Call Dragon shout to summon Odahviing

Paarthurnax, Arngeir, or Esbern reveal that Dragonsreach in Whiterun was originally built to hold other dragons. The plan is to capture one of Alduin's ilk and convince the captive to betray Alduin. Before that happens, however, you will need to convince Jarl of Whiterun first.

While Jarl Balgruuf (or whoever is in his place following the events of the Civil War ) fully comprehends the threat of the World-Eater looming over him like a dark shadow, an even greater threat - the clash between the Stormcloaks and Imperial Legion - perturbs him even more.

If you have not already done some of the Civil War quests , the quest Season Unending will now begin, during which you are to negotiate a peace council to help suspend the civil strife while the dragons are taken cared of. You will have to complete Season Unending (or pick a side) before you can continue with The Fallen.

Conversely, if you've already picked a side and captured nine Holds, then the jarl will let you proceed with The Fallen right away.

Learn the Call Dragon shout from Paarthurnax (if you had already picked a side in the Civil War) or Esbern. The latter will also give you the quest to slay Paarthurnax for his past crimes on humanity. Note that this is optional. Killing Paarthurnax will, understandably, upset Arngeir. However, he will still arrange the negotiations you need to complete The Fallen.

Using Call Dragon at the end of the balcony will call Odahviing to the area. As the dragon enters Dragonsreach, he will pick up the guard, leaving just the sword and torch behind.

From here this quest is really simple. Whenever you get the chance, hit the dragon with Dragonrend and run inside the large opening. The dragon will land on the balcony and follow you in and be captured by the trap waiting above.

Speak to Odahviing to negotiate an agreement to help each other. He'll explain that Alduin has gone to Skuldafn Temple, and will even agree to take you there if you release him.

When you are ready to go, talk to the nearby guard upstairs to free Odahviing, who you can now talk to and travel to Skuldafn Temple, starting The World-Eater's Eyrie quest.

articles.title: How to Buy a Settlement - Rob Run Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Settlements are smaller areas within districts, where multiple citizens can live together in Rob Run. You can rent out settlements to other players, which will
articles.body:
Settlements are smaller areas within districts, where multiple citizens can live together in Rob Run . You can rent out settlements to other players, which will earn you passive income through a small tax on their property. In this guide, we're going to break down everything you need to do to buy a Settlement in Rob Run .

You need to purchase the Settlement Title from the Black Market before you can get a Settlement. The unlock will cost you $100,000.

After you unlock it, the price of actually purchasing the Settlement Title is $200,000, meaning you need to have at least a total of $300,000 to get a Settlement Level 1 and start renting to players.

You'll collect taxes based on resident's financial actions while they live there. If you don't have anyone living there, though, no income goes to you. You can have random players join, or friends who are trying to work with you, to boost everyone's wealth.

articles.title: Dragon Age Fans Save One of the Series' Most Beloved Features
articles.summary: Dragon Age fans have saved one of the series’ most beloved features: being able to import your world states in each game.
articles.body:
Dragon Age fans have saved one of the series’ most beloved features: being able to import your world states in each game.

With the Mass Effect trilogy, this was simple: just play through the series on the same console, and your saves are automatically carried over. The same was true going from Dragon Age: Origins into Dragon Age 2. But by the time Dragon Age: Inquisition rolled around in 2014, a new console generation was upon us, so BioWare had to get creative.

This is when we get the Dragon Age Keep . This website connects to your EA account and keeps track of all the decisions you made in the previous games. Or, you can just input whatever decisions you want manually. You can then import this crafted world state into Dragon Age: Inquisition and see your previous choices reflected in the game.

I am sure many of you can already see the problem with this system: it’s an online service that needs to be maintained. True enough, the Dragon Age Keep experiences fairly frequent outages, during which time no one can start a new Inquisition run with their choices carried over.

Now that EA has shut down BioWare , it’s unclear what will happen if the Keep goes offline again, or how long EA plans to keep it going. Thankfully, fans already have a solution, at least if you’re on PC. A couple of modders have released user-friendly ways to adjust the game files so your choices still carry over, even if EA pulls the plug on the Dragon Age Keep.

First up, there’s Thedas World State Studio - Dragon Age Keep Utility by Nexus Mods user anshela. This gives you an offline alternative to the Keep, letting you input your choices in the same tapestry format you would in the online version.

This is much more user-friendly than previous methods of editing your world state on PC. As anyone who has tried will tell you, modding Inquisition is a nightmare thanks to the Frostbite engine, but this tool should make it much more accessible.

The modder says they were already working on this before the BioWare news hit, and the fact that it is ready now is just “good/bad timing." Indeed it is, because the next Dragon Age Keep outage could be the last.

Right now, the mod files have been “quarantined” while Nexus approves the latest version, so it can’t be downloaded just yet. But once it’s up and running again, it should work just fine, judging from the response from users so far.

This isn’t the only mod you’ll need if the servers go offline. The closest thing Inquisition has to New Game Plus lets you port almost all of your unlocks into future playthroughs, but for whatever reason, this also requires the Keep to be up, even though it’s only dealing with things you’ve unlocked in Inquisition.

That is where Thedas Chronicle - World State and Golden Nug Fix by TP1231 has us covered. This will let you access the Golden Nug statue that activates item transfers even if the servers are down. As the name suggests, it will also let you play with your imported world state when the Keep is offline, but you will still need the world state that you made while the servers are up.

While it’s great to see fans get these solutions out before EA potentially pulls the plug, it is no wonder that BioWare didn’t want to risk this happening ever again. Instead, Dragon Age: The Veilguard had us input previous choices in the game itself, so it could be played offline. Granted, we had far fewer options to carry over that time around, much to the frustration of fans, but at least it means we won’t have to go through this again.

In the meantime, BioWare fans are currently fighting to save the studio’s IPs. Most notably, the Save Mass Effect movement has amassed thousands of supporters, as they urge EA to do something with the IP, rather than let the series die.

Rhiannon (she/her) is a freelance journalist who has been in the industry since 2019. She won MCV's Women in Games award in 2025 and adores RPGs. You can follow her on Bluesky at @rhithewitch.

articles.title: GTA 6 Has a Whole Animated TV Series You Can Watch In-Game
articles.summary: In yet further evidence of the lengths Rockstar has gone to in order to pack GTA 6 to the brim with content, we have our first look at an animated TV series you can watch in-game.
articles.body:
In yet further evidence of the lengths Rockstar has gone to in order to pack GTA 6 to the brim with content, we have our first look at an animated TV series you can watch in-game.

The DiscussingFilm X / Twitter account posted a teaser for Macca & Friends, a cartoon Rockstar created for GTA 6’s Weazel television network, which is also found in both the 3D Universe and HD Universe of the Grand Theft Auto series.

Exclusive first look at ‘MACCA & FRIENDS’. The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida. Coming November 19 on WEAZEL. — DiscussingFilm (@DiscussingFilm) November 13, 2026

Exclusive first look at ‘MACCA & FRIENDS’. The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida. Coming November 19 on WEAZEL.

Macca & Friends has big Adult Swim vibes. It stars Pinche, a crab landlord who is going to kick out Macca the alligator if he doesn’t pay rent. There’s a talking sun, lots of other talking animals, and a police station. “The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida,” reads the description.

Reaction is a mix of disbelief that GTA 6 has an entire cartoon in the game itself to watch, and growing hype ahead of its November 19 release date. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson recently told The New York Times that it took him about 80 hours to finish the game back in February. He noted that playthrough included the main story and some "optional goals with narrative ramifications," so it's unclear if he sat down to watch some in-game telly. Still, that is a sizable length regardless. For comparison, GTA 4 and 5 are around 30 hours long, while Red Dead Redemption 2 is around 50-60 hours. So, that means GTA 6 will be the longest of Rockstar's games to date.

Indeed, an in-game TV series is exactly the kind of thing fans have come to expect from Rockstar, which operates on another level to most, if not all triple-A video game companies. We know GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make , but it is considered to be the most expensive video game of all time.

Rockstar has insisted GTA 6 did not cost more than $1.5 billion to make, countering an online rumor, but it’s still probably the most expensive video game of all time. A recent Bloomberg report confirmed that Rockstar Games now has 4,711 staff across 12 offices, up from the 2,441 staff it had when Red Dead Redemption 2 came out in 2018. The company has doubled in size over the last eight years, which will have increased costs significantly. But it also means Rockstar is able to do things like this cartoon, which for many fans won’t be of interest, but for some will be a fun distraction.

Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier said in a video accompaniment to his making of GTA 6 article that Rockstar told him of a scripted system in the game that makes dual protagonists Jason and Lucia — or, it sounds like, any character in the game — exert different amounts of sweat depending on how much effort they’re putting into whatever activity they’re doing. Indeed, Rockstar set up a new studio in Los Angeles packed with writers, producers, and directors, just to make NPCs.

Wesley is IGN's Managing Editor. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.

articles.title: Curt Pires and Ryan Quackenbush Announce Sci-Fi Graphic Novel Content
articles.summary: IGN can exclusively reveal a new preview of the Image Comics graphic novel Content, which spoofs our current climate of mindless content consumption and rampant AI use.
articles.body:
Curt Pires has built up a huge fan following in the comic book scene for his inventive work on books like the Star Wars/Tarantino mash-up Galactic and the Pokémon-spoofing Creature Corps . Pires is now teaming with artist Ryan Quackenbush (Junior Baker the Righteous Faker) for a new Image Comics graphic novel called Content, and it's a book that's perfect for our current age of mindless content consumption and rampant AI use.

IGN can exclusively reveal a new preview of Content. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below, but beware of some NSFW language:

Image Comics' Content: Exclusive Graphic Novel Preview

Here's Image's official summary of Content:

Fan-favorite creators Curt Pires (Creature Corps, Fireborn) and Ryan Quackenbush (Junior Baker the Righteous Faker) will team up for an all-new, original graphic novel titled, Content.

Inspired by Pires’ own time in the Hollywood dream factory, Content is set in the age of the infinite scroll. The perfect read for fans of Severance, Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, and The Social Network.

In a near-future ruled by streaming services, Trip Cruise is the most valuable mind in entertainment and the visionary architect behind the world’s biggest platform: Content. But when an experimental AI helmet meant to extract stories straight from his brain malfunctions, Trip becomes trapped inside the system he built: forced to navigate an endless hellscape of shows and fragmented memories.

His only shot at escape? Margot, his junior programmer and the only person with a strong enough human to him to take a shot at saving him. Together they’ll have to outsmart the machine designed to replace them or risk getting permanently deleted from existence.

Content will be released in comic shops on February 17 and in bookstores on March 16. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .

Also hitting stores in February 2027 are Batman: Reign of Assassins and a new Sabrina the Teenage Witch storyline .

Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

articles.title: God of War Sons of Sparta Coming to PS4 Next Week With New Content
articles.summary: Sony has revealed that God of War Sons of Sparta is coming to PS4 next week, and it's bringing two new modes with it.
articles.body:
Sony has revealed that God of War Sons of Sparta is coming to PS4 next week, and it's bringing two new modes with it.

The unexpected update for this year's action platformer prequel was announced in a PlayStation.Blog post today. In it, Sony confirmed plans to bring Kratos' earliest adventure to the last-gen console starting midnight local time November 16.

It's more than a surprise bonus platform, too, as developer Mega Cat Studios has promised two new modes that will be available on both PS4 and PS5: Hermes Mode and Erebus Mode. The former is described as a "race against the clock" that features speedrunning tools like a split-based timer and a persistent scoreboard. The latter is a one-hit-kill mode that affects both Kratos and his enemies.

Sony and Mega Cat tell God of War Sons of Sparta players that they'll be able to select their mode when starting a new game and selecting a save slot. Game modes can't be changed once selected. Hermes Mode, specifically, is activated only after beating the game once through and after players input the following code: Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, L1, R1, Touchpad. It's unclear if unlocking Erebus Mode has a similar old-school cheat code-esque requirement.

God of War Sons of Sparta takes one of PlayStation's most popular exclusive franchises and scales it down to let players control Kratos at a much, much earlier point in his life in ancient Greece. Shadow-dropped back in February of this year as an experimental chapter of the story for PS5, its story returns to an era fans have longed for with original Kratos actor Terrence 'T.C. Carson back in the booth.

"Every legend has a beginning – before he was a God, before he was a father, Kratos was a young Spartan!" an official story description said. "Experience an untold chapter in Kratos’ journey set during the harsh years of Spartan training alongside his brother Deimos. Through endless trials, their minds, bodies, and hearts have been molded to become Spartan soldiers for whom duty and honor mean everything. After a fellow cadet goes missing, Kratos and Deimos vow to find him and embark on an adventure that will put their training and Spartan spirit to the test."

God of War 20th Anniversary DualSense PS5 Controller

God of War Sons of Sparta was unable to generate the same level of hype the series' more recent entries have been known for. Despite the surprise of getting a new God of War game without any of the build-up, the prequel side-scroller generally received middling reviews from critics and fans. IGN gave it a 6/10 , calling it "a pretty mediocre Metroidvania" that failed "to meet the high bar set by the titans of the genre."

Franchise creator David Jaffe was less than impressed with God of War Sons of Sparta when it launched. In a video posted at the time, he said a 2.5D God of War game is "the kind of game I've always wanted" but ultimately said it was an experience he did not like and did not recommend. He even went as far as to say, "This is not God of War."

"I wanted to make a video more about what are they thinking, like what the f*** were they thinking?" Jaffe explained. "It's not a bad game by any means, it's fine, it controls decently... but to me the more fascinating part of this is, why is this in existence? I don't understand."

Like it or not, God of War Sons of Sparta offered a stopgap for Sony as it chipped away at the series' next major new entry: God of War Laufey . The PS5-exclusive title is currently set to launch May 20, 2027, following a recent delay . At least the prequel is now available for PS4 users to enjoy while they wait an extra few months.

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

articles.title: How to Get a Drill and Rob the Bank Vault - Rob Run Guide - IGN
articles.summary: If you're willing to take the risk,  you can raid the Looty Bay Bank on the northeast part of town in Rob Run, but it's tricky to pull off -
articles.body:
If you're willing to take the risk, you can raid the Looty Bay Bank on the northeast part of town in Rob Run , but it's tricky to pull off - you'll need to do it with a party, and you'll be fighting off multiple players who will try and stop you. Before you can even attempt it, there's specific gear that you'll need to get and bring with you. In this guide, we'll be walking you through everything you need to know about how to rob the bank in Rob Run.

You'll need a certain amount of gear if you want to gain access to the Looty Bay Bank Vault. You can't merely walk in.

You need a standard Dril l at the bare minimum. Having mini drills is also useful to open the smaller safes within the Bank Vault. If you want to unlock everything in the Bank Vault, you also need the ID Card , which unlocks the Gold Deposit room. However, the ID Card is not required to access the Bank Vault, but it allows you to collect a large quantity of gold.

The Drill is available at Lenny's Motel . Head inside the building, and make your way over to the Suspicious Door. Here, you'll be able to exchange some of the items you've collected while playing Rob Run. For the Drill, you need an Epic Action Camera , two USB Hacking Tools , and $50,000. This will give you access to the Drill.

Although not required, if you want to get as much loot as possible, the ID Card gives you access to the Bank Vault's gold vault. There's a bunch of gold there that you can sell for a solid amount of money.

The ID Card can also be obtained at the Suspicious Door at Lenny's Motel. There, you can exchange at least one Deposit Box Key for an ID Card.

Finally, you'll need Mini Drills. The Mini Drills are what you're going to use to unlock the larger safes once your inside. There are three safes that you can use these on inside of the bank vault.

When you have all of those items (or at least the Drill and Mini Drills), head over to the Looty Bay Bank on the northeast side of the map. You can enter through the front entrance, where you can explore much of the bank's first and second floors. Your primary goal is to reach the bottom floor, behind the teller's counter, where you'll find the vault.

The person who has the Drill won't be able to use it until they've changed their status to Criminal. When this happens, expect many of the alarms and sirens to begin going off as there are cameras on the first floor. You'll want to place the drill on the vault door immediately, as it takes one minute for the drill to punch through the vault.

After the drill breaks through, you have free reign of the vault and can begin looting. You'll find money on the central counter, a trio of vaults you can use the mini drills on the left side of the room, and several safety deposit boxes you can open on the right side. In the back of the room is the gold room, which you can only access if you have the ID Card.

Although you can grab as much as you want, expect nearly every player Cop on the server to know what's happening and speed over to you.

articles.title: Thunder Spear - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Thunder Spear is a martial-type Phantom Edge in Phantom Blade 0. It has a base damage of 450 and a lightning damage status effect buildup of 360.
articles.body:
The Thunder Spear is a martial-type Phantom Edge in Phantom Blade 0. It has a base damage of 450 and a lightning damage status effect buildup of 360.

Press R2 repeatedly to perform up to 3 strikes of [Thunderous Spear Art]. A full combo consumes 1 Remnant Spark. Attacks inflict Paralysis and unleash lightning.

The Thunder Spear does not have a use outside of combat.

How to Get the Thunder Spear in Phantom Blade 0

To obtain the Thunder Spear in Phantom Blade 0, you'll need to defeat Chang Hong, the Thunder Spear boss in Pangzhen. This is on the main story path, so you will not miss obtaining the Thunder Spear in your playthrough.

You can upgrade the Thunder Spear to unlock new abilities and buffs. Below you'll find a table that outlines everything you can unlock by upgrading it.

Soul-Tempering the Thunder Spear grants the ability Cascading Thunder : When Thunder Spear hits an enemy, lightning chains to up to two nearby enemies, dealing 100% and 50% of the original damage.

That's everything you need to know about the Thunder Spear in Phantom Blade 0. For more tips, tricks, and guides, be sure to check out our full walkthrough or our full weapon list.

articles.title: Panthers Week 10 injury report: Offense gets a big return vs. Saints
articles.summary: There are a handful of injury questions the Panthers will have to answer before Sunday. But they are getting the return of a huge presence on offense.
articles.body:
While their Week 10 injury report has looked relatively clean, the Carolina Panthers will still have to navigate into New Orleans through some muddy waters.

Wide receiver Xavier Legette (knee), offensive lineman Brady Christensen (hamstring), outside linebacker Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and cornerback Will Lee (hamstring) III are all considered questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Saints . Legette, Christensen and Phillips practiced in full in Friday while Lee was considered limited.

Carolina will likely be without running back Jonathon Brooks (groin) and cornerback Mike Jackson (groin)—both of whom are down as doubtful. In addition, linebacker Bobby Okereke has been ruled out due to his foot injury.

On the bright side, the Panthers will get a big return in left guard Damien Lewis—who was sidelined from the past two games with a knee issue.

Here's the injury report heading into the big NFC South showdown . . .

articles.title: Goldblaze - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Goldblaze is a ranged-type Phantom Edge in Phantom Blade 0. It has a base damage of 281 and a Guard Break of 151. Unlike many of the fantastical Phantom Edges
articles.body:
Goldblaze is a ranged-type Phantom Edge in Phantom Blade 0. It has a base damage of 281 and a Guard Break of 151. Unlike many of the fantastical Phantom Edges in Phantom Blade 0, this one is mainly just a firearm. Just like the Feathered Bow, Goldblaze can shoot down hanging objects.

Press R2 to fire from range. Press repeatedly to continue the firing sequence. A full firing sequence consumes 1. Deals increased damage to enemies at full HP

Ranged Shot: Once obtained, it can shoot down certain hanging objects at medium to long range, even when not equipped.

How to Get the Goldblaze in Phantom Blade 0

To obtain Goldblaze in Phantom Blade 0, you'll need to give Quick Hand Zhang every piece of treasure found in Pangzhen. Upon collecting all of them, you can hand them into Quick Hand Zhang, and he will reward you with Goldblaze.

You can upgrade the Goldblaze to unlock new abilities and buffs. Below you'll find a table that outlines everything you can unlock by upgrading it.

Soul-Tempering Goldblaze grants the ability Dodge Counter : Press L1+R2 with precise timing just before an enemy attack lands to perform a Perfect Dodge counterattack that deals greatly increased damage.

That's everything you need to know about Goldblaze in Phantom Blade 0. For more tips, tricks, and guides, be sure to check out our full walkthrough or our full weapon list.
